parsed.attack: Nobody ever receives an invitation: the corrected sample is written into one nurse's own HealthKit and every unit of value accrues to her alone, so the claimed community_embed loop is just the founder posting. r/nursing (~900k) and the large night-shift Facebook groups remove app promotion under self-promo rules, and the thing he would post has nothing to show - the output is a number inside Apple Health that looks identical to the number the wearable already wrote, and demonstrating it is better takes a full rotation to accumulate. App Store search, which drives about 65% of downloads, routes 'sleep' to AutoSleep, Pillow and Sleep Cycle with six-figure ratings counts, while 'shift work sleep' has almost no query volume, so installs arrive in tens against a $20-80 CPI he cannot pay.
parsed.strongest_defence: A hospital unit is a pre-made cluster - 8 to 15 nurses on the same rota, physically together for twelve hours, already comparing rings in the break room - so one nurse showing a corrected total converts colleagues who have the identical pain with a cycle time of a single shift, and clinical staff are heavy word-of-mouth adopters of narrow tools.
parsed.verdict_reason: There is no loop, only linear word of mouth inside shift clusters, which is genuinely free but caps at unit size and never compounds.
